hook: The Mongols sent Egypt a letter: surrender, or be destroyed. Egypt's answer shocked them.
title: The Mongols Said Surrender. Egypt Said No
desc:
In 1260 a Mongol embassy rode into Cairo with a letter for the sultan: surrender, or be destroyed.
Watch the full video on our YouTube channel.

hook: Four hundred and fifty merchants rode into a border city. None of them rode out.
title: The Massacre That Started the Mongol Invasion
desc:
Genghis Khan sent a caravan of about 450 merchants west. At Otrar the governor called them spies and had them killed.
Watch the full video on our YouTube channel.

#Shorts #History #Mongols #MiddleEast #AnimatedHistory

hook: He killed one envoy. It brought the whole Mongol army down on his empire.
title: He Executed Genghis Khan's Envoy
desc:
The Khwarazmian shah executed the lead Mongol envoy. To the Mongols it was the worst crime there was.
Watch the full video on our YouTube channel.

#Shorts #History #Mongols #MiddleEast #AnimatedHistory

hook: He ruled one of the richest empires on earth. He died hunted, on a tiny island.
title: The Shah Who Died Hunted on an Island
desc:
City after city fell to the Mongols. The shah fled west and died on a small island in the Caspian Sea.
Watch the full video on our YouTube channel.

#Shorts #History #Mongols #MiddleEast #AnimatedHistory

hook: For five hundred years, Baghdad was the capital of the caliphs. Then the Mongols arrived.
title: The Day Baghdad Fell to the Mongols
desc:
Baghdad had been the Abbasid capital for 500 years. In February 1258 it surrendered to Hulagu's army.
Watch the full video on our YouTube channel.

#Shorts #History #Mongols #MiddleEast #AnimatedHistory

hook: Writers said the river Tigris ran black with ink.
title: When the Tigris Ran Black With Ink
desc:
Baghdad was sacked for about a week. Later writers said the Tigris ran black with ink from the books thrown into it.
Watch the full video on our YouTube channel.

#Shorts #History #Mongols #MiddleEast #AnimatedHistory

hook: The Mongols would not spill royal blood. So they found another way to kill the caliph.
title: How the Mongols Killed the Last Caliph
desc:
According to the accounts, the caliph was rolled in a carpet and trampled by horses. The Abbasid caliphate in Baghdad was over.
Watch the full video on our YouTube channel.

#Shorts #History #Mongols #MiddleEast #AnimatedHistory

hook: Egypt was ruled by soldiers who had been bought as boys.
title: The Slave Soldiers Who Ruled Egypt
desc:
The Mamluks were bought as boys, trained for war and freed. One of them was a Kipchak Turk named Baybars.
Watch the full video on our YouTube channel.

#Shorts #History #Mongols #MiddleEast #AnimatedHistory

hook: The sultan read the Mongol letter. Then he hung the envoys' heads on Cairo's gate.
title: Egypt's Answer to the Mongols
desc:
Sultan Qutuz read Hulagu's letter, then had the Mongol envoys executed. There was no going back.
Watch the full video on our YouTube channel.

#Shorts #History #Mongols #MiddleEast #AnimatedHistory

hook: A death on the other side of the world may have saved Egypt.
title: The Death That Saved Egypt
desc:
The Great Khan Möngke died in China. Hulagu took most of his army east, leaving Kitbuqa behind.
Watch the full video on our YouTube channel.

#Shorts #History #Mongols #MiddleEast #AnimatedHistory

hook: The Mamluks beat the Mongols with the Mongols' own favourite trick.
title: The Trick That Beat the Mongols
desc:
Baybars attacked, then pretended to run, and drew Kitbuqa's army into the hills where the main Mamluk army waited.
Watch the full video on our YouTube channel.

#Shorts #History #Mongols #MiddleEast #AnimatedHistory

hook: With the battle almost lost, the sultan threw off his helmet.
title: The Sultan Who Threw Off His Helmet
desc:
The Mongols almost broke through. Qutuz threw off his helmet so his men could see him, and charged.
Watch the full video on our YouTube channel.

#Shorts #History #Mongols #MiddleEast #AnimatedHistory

hook: For the first time, a Mongol army was beaten in open battle, and the defeat stuck.
title: The First Mongol Defeat That Stuck
desc:
Ain Jalut was the first time a major Mongol army was beaten in open battle and the defeat held. The advance toward Egypt stopped.
Watch the full video on our YouTube channel.

#Shorts #History #Mongols #MiddleEast #AnimatedHistory

hook: He won the battle that saved Egypt. His own officer killed him on the way home.
title: He Saved Egypt. His Officer Killed Him
desc:
On the way home from Ain Jalut, Baybars and other officers killed Qutuz, and Baybars became sultan.
Watch the full video on our YouTube channel.

#Shorts #History #Mongols #MiddleEast #AnimatedHistory

hook: The empire that destroyed Baghdad ended up adopting the faith of the people it conquered.
title: The Mongols Who Became Muslims
desc:
Berke of the Golden Horde became a Muslim, and in 1295 Ghazan, Hulagu's great-grandson, converted with his court.
Watch the full video on our YouTube channel.
